author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a right-facing pistol drill with rounded rear, motor/chuck divider, round nose and bit, a 1:3 slanted grip with a tangent rounded base, held by an L arm down and to the right, as in the reference. A first grip reaching y=35 left the base 7.1 from the arm foot (gate internal-spacing) and was shortened.
omissions: The chuck is the rounded nose of the body rather than a separate taller box; the grip is shorter than the reference's so the arm foot keeps 8 units.
drawing_plan: SQUARE: body top y=6 x6..36 with r6 rear corner and r6 nose about (30,12), underside y=18, grip (16,18)-(19,27) / (9,27)-(6,18) with two-cubic base to (14,32); divider x=24; bit (36,12)-(42,12); arm (14,32)-(14,42)-(26,42).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'drill': rounded motor body, nose chuck, projecting bit and slanted grip.
